candidate_solution.summary: Split session-local compaction protection from parent-owned workflow lifecycle and register it in teammate children.

findings.description: Every teammate process receives PI_TEAMMATE_CHILD=1 and explicitly loads the inherited Maestro extension, but the extension immediately returns after registering the child surface. That surface has no context, agent_end, or agent_settled hooks, so a length-truncated teammate response never enters onOutputLimit and never reaches settlePendingOutputLimit. The parent may therefore consume a partial teammate result without the compaction-and-continue recovery that root sessions receive.
findings.invariant_broken: A length-truncated session that is eligible for pressure recovery must either settle its stored output-limit intent or explicitly report that recovery is unavailable.
findings.minimal_fix: Extract a child-safe, session-local compaction registration that owns its own CompactionArbiter and auto-compaction state, then call it from registerMaestroChildSurface. Register only compaction hooks (session_start/context/before_provider_request/agent_end/agent_settled/session_before_compact/session_compact/session_shutdown); continue excluding parent-owned Workflow, Goal, Plan, and root Todo lifecycle hooks.
findings.test_gap: Extend the PI_TEAMMATE_CHILD extension harness to emit a high-pressure length agent_end followed by agent_settled and assert that child-local compact plus continuation occurs. The current test only asserts that agent_end is absent, conflating parent Goal ownership with all session-local end-of-turn behavior.

findings.description: K2 is fixed for root sessions by disableInvalidBudgetThinking plus before_provider_request wiring, but the PI_TEAMMATE_CHILD early return omits that hook. A child that reaches the same clamped Anthropic payload can still send max_tokens <= budget_tokens and receive a deterministic provider error. Static wiring proves exposure; this review did not reproduce the upstream Pi clamp in a live child, so triage remains risk rather than live.
findings.invariant_broken: Anthropic budget_tokens must be at least 1024 and strictly less than max_tokens in every provider request, independent of root or child session ownership.
findings.minimal_fix: At minimum, register a child before_provider_request hook that calls disableInvalidBudgetThinking. This guard has no parent-owned state and can be shared immediately even before the larger child compaction surface is extracted.
findings.test_gap: In child mode, emit before_provider_request with max_tokens=1 and budget_tokens=1024 and assert thinking is disabled.

findings.description: The root-session handoff is closed: onCompact snapshots whether a native completion should continue a pending output-limit response before clearing state, while session_compact captures the arbiter owner before complete(). Existing tests cover both yielding before settlement and continuing after native completion.
findings.minimal_fix: No root-path code change; preserve the owner-before-complete ordering and port the same invariant into any child-local compaction registration.

known_issue_assessment.assessment: The obsolete native /swarm execution path no longer calls sendUserMessage with /skill:name; current swarm.ts is display-only and tells the user to invoke the skill directly. Permission parsing also accepts file_path and path. The underlying SDK expansion behavior may remain, but the cited integration path is gone.
Fixed in the root hook chain, but a derivative exposure remains in teammate children because child registration omits before_provider_request.
onCompact now persists the cleared prune manifest immediately, preventing stale prune entries from surviving a close before the next evaluate.
session_before_compact now calls commitProjectedCompactionInput before createMaestroCompaction, keeping Pi's fallback closure aligned with the projected preparation.
The proposed shared compaction root cause remains refuted; claude_model_required is an independent remote routing issue and no compaction cooperation edge was found for it in this path.

verification.command: node --experimental-transform-types --test --test-name-pattern=output-limit|provider request hook|teammate child registers test/compaction.test.ts test/extension-tools.test.ts
verification.interpretation: Root deferred/native behavior and current child hook omission are both reproducible; no child-specific compaction or budget-guard test exists.
